english.note: Use this for the emotional tie holding people together, especially in a friendship or family relationship.

exampleSentences.english: We grew up playing together, so our bond is very strong.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋由細玩到大，感情好深。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau4 sai3 waan2 dou3 daai6 gam2 cing4 hou2 sam1

english.note: Use this for the romantic or sexual side of a relationship, especially when talking about whether two people are romantically involved.

exampleSentences.english: They’ve been dating for six months, and their relationship is still great.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋拍拖半年，感情仲好好。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 paak3 to1 bun3 nin4 gam2 cing4 zung6 hou2 hou2
